item.title: GitHub Spec Kit: give the AI agent a spec, not a vibe
item.description: Ask Claude, Codex, or Gemini to “build me an ERP with auth, billing, a dashboard, and a mobile app” and you’ll get something that half works and is architecturally cursed in ways you won’t notice until week three. The model isn’t bad at writing code. It’s bad at simultaneously inventing the product, the architecture, and the implementation order while also writing the code. GitHub’s Spec Kit exists to split those apart.
